body:
## Expected Behavior

When sending links to be associated with a workflow, NexusOperation links are accepted.

## Actual Behavior

NexusOperation links are rejected as an unsupported variant.

## Steps to Reproduce the Problem

  1. Send a StartWorkflowExecutionRequest where the [Links](https://github.com/temporalio/api/blob/57de820b3952b02f7302a1a46a28fd94cee1007a/temporal/api/workflowservice/v1/request_response.proto#L194) field contains a valid [Link.NexusOperation](https://github.com/temporalio/api/blob/57de820b3952b02f7302a1a46a28fd94cee1007a/temporal/api/common/v1/message.proto#L251) variant.
  2. Observe the unsupported variant rejection from the server.
title: StartWorkflow Rejects Valid Link.NexusOperation Variant
